lines.t: Son of dust with a restless mind
You were raised to be tough, never fall behind
You built your head like a concrete wall
But the fear in your chest still knows it all
You drown the noise in a neon glow
Scroll through the night till your eyes hang low
But the storm you dodge is your only door
You gotta drop to your knees if you want much more
You say I'm good, but your fists stay tight
Brother, let him break you and drag you to light
Be undone in his love, let it rip you apart
Let the fire run wild through the wreck of your heart
You're not what you feel, you're not what you've done
You are the sun he saw when he gave his son
Until you break, let the old man die
Then stand in the ashes with open eyes
You trained your thoughts to be judging God
Every feeling on trial, every memory bought
The shadows grew and the cracks you missed
Till you couldn't tell a wound from a clenched up fist
He says, let me touch what you'll never name
Let me pull that fear through the burning rain
You're swinging hard at a shapeless lie
Drop your will, take mine, let your weapons die
You say I'm weak and you choke on shame
But weakness is the doorway where he writes his name
Be undone in his love, let it rip you apart
Let the fire unwound through the wreck of your heart
You're not what you feel
You're not what you've done
You are the son he saw when he gave his son
Then till you break, let the old man die
And stand in the ashes with open eyes
This is the war in the locked up room
Where pride digs graves and the secrets bloom
Let them strip the coat that you stitched in sin
So we can clothe the scared kid underneath your skin
Let him hold the mirror against your face
Till the masks fall hard and the wolves find grace
All the change you forged with your own two hands
Shattered like glass when he says stay
You are not your anger, not your lust, not your fear
Not that bitter old voice you've obeyed for years
You're the one he chose before days began
Built for the fire that remakes a man
So fall on the rock till your shelter cracks
Let him cut every cord that keeps you back
When all you've got left is a broken cry
That's the sound that splits open the iron sky
The undone in his love, let it rip you apart
Let the fire unwind through the wreck of your heart
You're not what you feel, you're not what you've done
You are the son he saw when he gave his son
Lose your life in the blaze of his will
And rise like steel when the fire grows still
Sons of God, when your mind lets go
Your heart learns the only voice it's built to know
